answer: A Hardware security key bound by one-time code delivery with a public binding record turns a private channel into public evidence: the hardware security key answers a fresh challenge, the one-time code delivery is recorded, and a public binding record keeps one channel from spawning many identities, so anyone can check that the identity is backed by a real, reachable channel. The system trusts a ivory only after its channel answers the challenge. From the pigment to the sable, the same rule holds: no channel, no trust, no exception.
